text.text_excerpt: Shamrock is a very...unique place lol. They have ALOT going on in there! I feel like no matter what day nor time of day I visit, there is little-to-no parking in the GIANT strip mall lot it's attached to lol. I wouldn't want to park too far from the entrance if I were alone just because there's lots of activity in the lot and area. When you arrive, prepare to walk up approx. 3 flights of stairs. Also, depending on the day and time and I guess the way the wind blows, you may or may not be patted down. Of course there's a full bar and kitchen with bar food (burgers, wings, fries), but also, I've been very surprised to see that they have foods like steak and potatoes lol. The drinks are very...

I can't believe I haven't been to the Shamrock before this weekend. What a cool bar. In the old Rock n Bowl location, they have pool tables, darts, ping pong cages, foosball, a claw machine; who could ask for anything more in a bar! I found the staff to be super friendly; the bartender was even patient enough to pour me a half and half (Harp and Guinness- mmm!) without complaining or rolling her eyes. The ladies room has a "lounge" with TVs and seating and there are all kinds of places to put your drink down without worry. The talk of adding things like skeeball and mini bowling only make it more enticing. The two minuses were a lack of local beer on tap and the fact that it was pretty sm...

Shamrock is like a neighborhood Dave and busters. No frills but still fun. Great food at good prices but I don't like this artichoke dip. It's so oniony, but other than that I've always loved the food. The drinks are cheap and good. Sometimes there is live music but I'd prefer a Dj. This places has tons of games. Video pokers, beer pong, pool, arcade games and more. It's a fun date night (Not a first date, an already in a relationship date). It's a cool place to hang with friends. The crowd is diverse all types come here.
